notes.title: Thanks for Wishlisting Spark!
notes.content:
Hello!
Thank you for wishlisting Spark!  We are very excited to be sharing what we have been doing with the world. We will be using the Spark page as much as we can make announcements, and we also have a discord server that you can interact with the team and the community: https://discord.gg/X9epNhy

You can also check out our Spark game webpage for more updates and some of the backstory of the game and development: https://www.sparkmoba.net

We look forward to connecting with you all!
